backendIsolatedBasic.scope: Exact 0.5.31 route and transaction/resource envelope against a disposable live-data clone. Actual account and IAM directory, no public HTTP transport, middleware JWT verification, Nginx gzip or GUI. All writes target the clone; no business logic changes.

workspaceDedupeExperiment.scope: Request-scoped pending-task sharing inside the same clone transaction. Counterbalanced order, first pair excluded. No production changes.

permissionDefaultExperiment.scope: In the clone only, normalize omitted includeDeleted to false before the existing memoized permission check. Counterbalanced order, first pair excluded. This is not a production implementation.

modelReferenceCpuMicrobenchmark.scope: CPU-only serialization microbenchmark on the exact five current library models from the disposable clone; excludes route/network/permission/migration time.

interpretation: Backend helper excludes normal HTTP JWT middleware, public network, Nginx/gzip and renderer. SQL includes BEGIN/COMMIT. Method wall times overlap. CPU microbenchmark is not an end-to-end latency reduction. No improvement claim from workspace dedupe; permission samples overlap.
